roadmap.title: Settle in: first base and everyday chores
roadmap.description: Claim a base, search containers, recruit and build facilities, and get the first kills and surveys.

roadmap.title: Run the community: enclaves, leaders and skills
roadmap.description: Ally with enclaves, earn Standing, elect leaders, build leader facilities, pick specializations and take bounties.

roadmap.title: Hunt the plague: hearts, freaks, hordes and outposts
roadmap.description: Destroy hearts, infestations and hordes, kill the special zombies, claim outposts and landmarks, and clear the Homecoming story.

roadmap.title: Finish campaigns and legacies
roadmap.description: Destroy every heart in a territory, finish a campaign under each leader's legacy and start a new community from a finished one.

roadmap.title: Heartland
roadmap.description: Play the separate Heartland story: recruit its survivors, destroy plague walls and complete its facility, weapon and cure goals.

roadmap.title: Daybreak
roadmap.description: Defend the technician in Daybreak sessions, collect prestige and CLEO drops and build the Red Talon and CLEO Relay facilities.

roadmap.title: Dread, Nightmare and Lethal challenge runs
roadmap.description: Play campaigns at Dread, Nightmare and Lethal minimum difficulty and finish their zone-specific goals.

roadmap.title: Long grinds
roadmap.description: Finish the largest counters: 10,000 kills, 343 Daybreak waves, 100 plague cures, 20 plague walls and four Dread or Nightmare legacy runs.

achievements.description: Kill 100 Zombies.
achievements.summary: Kill a running total of 100 zombies.

steps.text: Kill zombies until your total reaches 100.
steps.note: The total carries over between playthroughs.

achievements.description: Have a Survivor within your Community die.
achievements.summary: Lose one of your community's survivors to death.

steps.text: Let a survivor in your community die.
steps.note: Carry fewer items on that survivor first so there is less to recover.

achievements.description: Search 10 Containers.
achievements.summary: Search ten containers.

steps.text: Search containers in houses and other buildings until you have searched ten.

achievements.description: Search 100 Containers.
achievements.summary: Search one hundred containers.

steps.text: Keep searching containers in buildings until you have searched one hundred.

achievements.description: Deliver a Rucksack to your Storage Facility.
achievements.summary: Bring a rucksack to your Storage Facility.

steps.text: Carry a @item{rucksack} back to your base and deliver it to the Storage Facility.

achievements.displayName: I Got You a Pack Mule
achievements.description: Deliver 50 Rucksacks to your Storage Facility.
achievements.summary: Bring fifty rucksacks to your Storage Facility.

steps.text: Keep delivering @item{rucksack}s from your runs to the Storage Facility until fifty have been delivered.

achievements.description: Build a Facility at your Base.
achievements.summary: Build any facility at your base.

steps.text: Build a facility in one of your base's slots.

achievements.description: Build 10 Facilities at your Base.
achievements.summary: Build ten facilities at your base.

steps.text: Fill your base's slots until it holds ten built facilities.

achievements.description: Destroy a Plague Heart.
achievements.summary: Destroy one Plague Heart.

steps.text: Enter the house holding the @enemy{Plague Heart} and kill the plague zombies that spawn inside.
Set remote explosives, or throw grenades or pipe bombs, until the heart nears bursting.
Back away as soon as the heart lights up and swells, then detonate from a safe distance.
steps.note: Staying close exposes you to gas that gives plague and a lasting injury, and the heart calls zombies.

achievements.description: Destroy 5 Plague Hearts.
achievements.summary: Destroy five Plague Hearts.

steps.text: Destroy @enemy{Plague Heart}s one by one until five are gone.
steps.note: Each heart needs its own run of clearing the house, placing explosives and backing off.

achievements.description: Recruit a new Survivor to your Community.
achievements.summary: Add a newly recruited survivor to your community.

steps.text: Do a side mission for an enclave or a stray survivor.
Recruit one survivor from the mission.
steps.note: An allied enclave lets you take one member and the rest leave, so check the survivor's traits with Learn More about Survivor first.

achievements.description: Survey 5 Sites with your Binoculars.
achievements.summary: Survey five sites by looking at them through your binoculars.

steps.text: Climb a billboard or radio tower that has a binocular icon on the map.
Aim to look around from the top and keep your view on each question mark until it changes.
steps.note: Five revealed marks complete this one.

achievements.description: Survey 50 Sites with your Binoculars.
achievements.summary: Survey fifty sites by looking at them through your binoculars.

steps.text: Climb billboards and radio towers marked with binocular icons.
Look at each question mark from the top until it changes, and keep going until fifty have changed.
steps.note: One tower never shows all fifty, so use many towers.

achievements.description: Cause a commotion while searching a Container.
achievements.summary: Make noise that draws zombies while searching a container.

steps.text: At a container, hold search together with the faster-search modifier.
Search more containers this way until a search makes enough noise to attract zombies.
steps.note: It is chance-based and usually shows up within a few tries.

achievements.description: Earn enough Standing to promote a Recruit to Citizen.
achievements.summary: Earn enough Standing for a Recruit survivor to be promoted to Citizen.

steps.text: Earn @mechanic{Standing} with a Recruit through zombie kills, delivering supplies, completed missions, cleared Infestations or destroyed Plague Hearts.
steps.note: The progress bar sits in the survivor's bio tab.

achievements.description: Earn enough Standing to promote a Citizen to Hero.
achievements.summary: Earn enough Standing for a Citizen survivor to be promoted to Hero.

steps.text: Keep earning @mechanic{Standing} with a Citizen through kills, deliveries, missions and heart or Infestation clears.
steps.note: Check progress in the bio tab.

achievements.description: Secure 5 Sites by exploring every room and killing every zombie.
achievements.summary: Fully clear five sites by entering every room and killing all their zombies.

steps.text: Enter a site and walk into every room until the minimap room counter is complete.
Kill any zombies on the property.
steps.note: Do this at five different sites.

achievements.displayName: Every Piece of Trash in Town
achievements.description: Secure 25 Sites by exploring every room and killing every zombie.
achievements.summary: Fully clear twenty-five sites by entering every room and killing all their zombies.

steps.text: Keep entering every room of sites and killing their zombies until twenty-five sites are cleared.

achievements.description: Destroy an Infestation.
achievements.summary: Destroy one Infestation.

steps.text: Find an @enemy{Infestation} on your map and destroy it.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 Infestations.
achievements.summary: Destroy ten Infestations.

steps.text: Keep finding @enemy{Infestation}s and destroying them until you have ten.

achievements.description: Destroy a Horde.
achievements.summary: Destroy one Horde.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Horde} and kill it off.
steps.note: A sturdy vehicle with plenty of healing kits helps.

achievements.description: Destroy 25 Hordes.
achievements.summary: Destroy twenty-five Hordes.

steps.text: Keep destroying @enemy{Horde}s until you have destroyed twenty-five.

achievements.description: Kill 50 Zombies with your car door.
achievements.summary: Kill fifty zombies by hitting them with your car door.

steps.text: While driving, hold the door button so the car door swings into zombies.
steps.note: Keep going until fifty zombies have died to the door.

achievements.description: Kill a Feral.
achievements.summary: Kill one Feral.

steps.text: Kill a @enemy{Feral} zombie.

achievements.description: Kill a Bloater.
achievements.summary: Kill one Bloater.

steps.text: Kill a @enemy{Bloater}.

achievements.description: Kill a Juggernaut.
achievements.summary: Kill one Juggernaut.

steps.text: Kill a @enemy{Juggernaut}.

achievements.description: Call in a Radio Command.
achievements.summary: Send one command over the radio.

steps.text: Open the radio menu from your inventory or the D-pad.
Choose any radio command.

achievements.description: Call in 25 Radio Commands.
achievements.summary: Send twenty-five commands over the radio in total.

steps.text: Keep opening the radio and sending commands until you have sent twenty-five.

achievements.description: Shoot the helmet off an Armored Zombie.
achievements.summary: Knock the helmet off an armored zombie with gunfire.

steps.text: Find an armored zombie wearing a helmet; SWAT-type ones are the most common.
Shoot its head until the helmet flies off.
steps.note: It takes several headshots.

achievements.description: Choose a Specialization for the Cardio skill.
achievements.summary: Choose a specialization for the Cardio core skill.

steps.text: Sprint with a survivor until their Cardio skill reaches its first-tier maximum.
From the character menu, open the skills screen and take one of the two specializations on offer.

achievements.description: Choose a Specialization for the Wits skill.
achievements.summary: Choose a specialization for the Wits core skill.

steps.text: Raise a survivor's Wits by stealth kills or by searching containers until it hits its first-tier maximum.
From the character menu, open the skills screen and take one of the two specializations on offer.

achievements.description: Choose a Specialization for the Fighting skill.
achievements.summary: Choose a specialization for the Fighting core skill.

steps.text: Use melee weapons with a survivor until their Fighting skill reaches its first-tier maximum.
From the character menu, open the skills screen and take one of the two specializations on offer.

achievements.description: Choose a Specialization for the Shooting skill.
achievements.summary: Choose a specialization for the Shooting core skill.

steps.text: Shoot with a survivor until their Shooting skill reaches its first-tier maximum.
steps.note: Control that survivor yourself while it levels.

steps.text: From the character menu, open the skills screen and take one of the two specializations on offer.

achievements.description: Elect a Warlord as the Leader of your Community.
achievements.summary: Elect a survivor with the Warlord leader trait as your community's leader.

guide.context: A survivor must be a Hero first. A leader who is demoted only loses Hero status, so you may elect another leader afterward.

steps.text: Raise a survivor with the Warlord leader trait to Hero.
Elect that survivor as leader.

achievements.description: Elect a Sheriff as the Leader of your Community.
achievements.summary: Elect a survivor with the Sheriff leader trait as your community's leader.

guide.context: A survivor must be a Hero first. A leader who is demoted only loses Hero status, so you may elect another leader afterward.

steps.text: Raise a survivor with the Sheriff leader trait to Hero.
Elect that survivor as leader.

achievements.description: Elect a Trader as the Leader of your Community.
achievements.summary: Elect a survivor with the Trader leader trait as your community's leader.

guide.context: A survivor must be a Hero first. A leader who is demoted only loses Hero status, so you may elect another leader afterward.

steps.text: Raise a survivor with the Trader leader trait to Hero.
Elect that survivor as leader.

achievements.displayName: Can We Fix It? Yes We Can!
achievements.description: Elect a Builder as the Leader of your Community.
achievements.summary: Elect a survivor with the Builder leader trait as your community's leader.

guide.context: A survivor must be a Hero first. A leader who is demoted only loses Hero status, so you may elect another leader afterward.

steps.text: Raise a survivor with the Builder leader trait to Hero.
Elect that survivor as leader.

achievements.description: Destroy every Plague Heart in your Territory.
achievements.summary: Destroy every Plague Heart in your current territory.

guide.context: The number of hearts in a territory varies by difficulty, from 6 up to 18.

steps.text: Open your map and mark every @enemy{Plague Heart} shown in the territory.
Destroy each heart in turn.
If the map shows too few hearts, search for the rest.
steps.note: A Survey car on the main roads helps, and the drone from the last command center upgrade does too.

achievements.description: Switch to a different Survivor when you become Fatigued.
achievements.summary: Switch to a different survivor while your current one is fatigued.

steps.text: Play until a Zzz symbol appears on your character's blue stamina bar.
Talk to another survivor and switch to that survivor.

achievements.displayName: Be Still My Dog of War
achievements.description: Complete a campaign with the Warlord's Legacy.
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign with the Warlord leader's Legacy mission.

guide.context: Finishing a campaign deletes the community's map and base. The game asks for confirmation just before the final mission.

steps.text: Take down all @enemy{Plague Heart}s in the territory.
Elect a Warlord survivor as leader.
Finish the Warlord's Legacy mission.
steps.note: The mission has you threaten or fight enclaves around town with one follower.

achievements.description: Complete a campaign with the Sheriff's Legacy.
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign with the Sheriff leader's Legacy mission.

guide.context: Finishing a campaign deletes the community's map and base. The game asks for confirmation just before the final mission.

steps.text: Take down all @enemy{Plague Heart}s in the territory.
Elect a Sheriff survivor as leader.
Finish the Sheriff's Legacy mission.
steps.note: The final fight is against six enemies at once with no backup; kill their leader to end it.

achievements.description: Complete a campaign with the Trader's Legacy.
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign with the Trader leader's Legacy mission.

guide.context: Finishing a campaign deletes the community's map and base. The game asks for confirmation just before the final mission.

steps.text: Take down all @enemy{Plague Heart}s in the territory.
Elect a Trader survivor as leader.
Finish the Trader's Legacy mission.
steps.note: You have backup in the final fight.

achievements.displayName: If You Build It, They Will Come
achievements.description: Complete a campaign with the Builder's Legacy.
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign with the Builder leader's Legacy mission.

guide.context: Finishing a campaign deletes the community's map and base. The game asks for confirmation just before the final mission.

steps.text: Take down all @enemy{Plague Heart}s in the territory.
Elect a Builder survivor as leader.
Finish the Builder's Legacy mission.
steps.note: The final fight is against a small group inside your base with everyone helping.

achievements.description: Claim a base on the Cascade Hills map.
achievements.summary: Set up your community's base in Cascade Hills.

guide.context: Moving the community to another map keeps your Influence, characters and stash.

steps.text: Tap the move-community icon on your map to relocate.
Establish a base on @loc{Cascade Hills}.

achievements.description: Claim a base on the Drucker County map.
achievements.summary: Set up your community's base in Drucker County.

guide.context: Moving the community to another map keeps your Influence, characters and stash.

steps.text: Tap the move-community icon on your map to relocate.
Establish a base on @loc{Drucker County}.

achievements.description: Claim a base on the Meagher Valley map.
achievements.summary: Set up your community's base in Meagher Valley.

guide.context: Moving the community to another map keeps your Influence, characters and stash.

steps.text: Tap the move-community icon on your map to relocate.
Establish a base on @loc{Meagher Valley}.

achievements.description: Start a new Campaign with Survivors from a completed one.
achievements.summary: Start a new campaign using survivors carried over from a finished one.

steps.text: Finish a campaign.
Start a new community and bring up to three survivors from the finished one.
steps.note: Their gear and rucksacks come too.

achievements.displayName: Sie sind das Essen und wir sind
achievements.description: Shoot off a Flare (or volunteer to help someone who does).
achievements.summary: Fire a flare from the radio, or join someone else's flare.

steps.text: Open the radio from the D-pad menu.
Choose Ask for Help to fire a flare, or Volunteer to Help to answer another player's flare.
You may cancel matchmaking right away.
steps.note: The flare itself is what counts.

achievements.description: Kill 1,000 Zombies.
achievements.summary: Kill a running total of one thousand zombies.

steps.text: Keep killing zombies until your total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Kill 10,000 Zombies.
achievements.summary: Kill a running total of ten thousand zombies.

steps.text: Keep killing zombies until your total reaches 10,000.
steps.note: A sturdy vehicle and plenty of healing kits make hordes the fastest source.

achievements.displayName: From the Top of My Lungs
achievements.description: Kill 4 Screamers.
achievements.summary: Kill four Screamers.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Screamer}s until four have died.

achievements.displayName: What We Do in the Shadows
achievements.description: Destroy a Plague Heart at night.
achievements.summary: Destroy a Plague Heart during the night.

steps.text: Pick a night when you are near a marked @enemy{Plague Heart}.
Destroy the heart before dawn.
steps.note: Dawn arriving before the heart dies means it does not count.

achievements.description: Use the Auto Shop to create an armor upgrade and apply it to a vehicle.
achievements.summary: Create an armor upgrade for a vehicle at the Auto Shop and apply it.

steps.text: Craft an armor upgrade at the Auto Shop; it costs materials and parts.
Park the vehicle on its base parking spot.
Apply the upgrade to the vehicle from that parking spot.

achievements.description: Transfer an item from a vehicle's inventory directly into your base.
achievements.summary: Move an item from a vehicle's trunk straight into your base stash.

steps.text: Park the vehicle on the marked parking spot at your base until its indicator reads Parked.
Open the trunk.
Press the stash transfer button shown in the bar below the inventory.
steps.note: A @item{rucksack} works as the item.

achievements.description: Build the Trade Depot facility at your base.
achievements.summary: Construct the Trade Depot at your base.

steps.text: While a Trader is your leader, build the @loc{Trade Depot} in a large slot at your base.
steps.note: Large slots only accept leader facilities while that leader type is elected.

achievements.description: Build the Field Hospital facility at your base.
achievements.summary: Construct the Field Hospital at your base.

steps.text: While a Sheriff is your leader, build the @loc{Field Hospital} in a large slot at your base.
steps.note: Large slots only accept leader facilities while that leader type is elected.

achievements.description: Build the Armory facility at your base.
achievements.summary: Construct the Armory at your base.

steps.text: While a Warlord is your leader, build the @loc{Armory} in a large slot at your base.
steps.note: Large slots only accept leader facilities while that leader type is elected. It needs a large outdoor slot.

achievements.description: Build the Sniper Tower facility at your base.
achievements.summary: Construct the Sniper Tower at your base.

steps.text: While a Builder is your leader, build the @loc{Sniper Tower} in a large slot at your base.
steps.note: Large slots only accept leader facilities while that leader type is elected. It needs a large outdoor slot.

achievements.description: Finish off a Juggernaut with a melee execution.
achievements.summary: Kill a Juggernaut using a melee execution as the finishing blow.

steps.text: Wear down a @enemy{Juggernaut} until it stumbles and drops to one knee.
Run to it quickly and press the execution button.
steps.note: The knee drop comes after its third stumble.

achievements.description: Work with 5 Enclaves to make them your Allies.
achievements.summary: Make five enclaves your Allies.

steps.text: Follow each enclave's mission prompts until it shows as Allied.
Ignoring requests can turn an enclave hostile.
steps.note: Missions left too long vanish for good, and a new enclave moves in later.

achievements.description: Spend Influence to buy 10 items from Enclaves.
achievements.summary: Pay Influence to buy ten items from enclaves.

steps.text: Spend Influence buying items from enclaves until you have bought ten.

achievements.description: Earn Influence by selling 10 items to Enclaves.
achievements.summary: Earn Influence by selling ten items to enclaves.

steps.text: Sell items to enclaves for Influence until you have sold ten.

achievements.displayName: That was it? This is easy.
achievements.description: Survive to the second wave in a session of Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Survive until the second wave begins in a Daybreak session.

steps.text: Start a Daybreak session and defend the technician through the first wave.

achievements.description: Survive 7 total zombie waves in Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Survive a combined total of 7 zombie waves across Daybreak sessions.

steps.text: Play Daybreak sessions and survive waves until your running total reaches seven.
steps.note: Waves from different sessions add together.

achievements.description: Earn a total of 500 Prestige playing Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Earn a combined total of 500 Prestige from Daybreak sessions.

steps.text: Play Daybreak sessions and survive waves until your earned Prestige totals 500.

achievements.description: Achieve victory in a session of Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Win a Daybreak session by surviving it through to victory.

steps.text: Defend the technician through every wave of a Daybreak session until the game declares victory.

achievements.description: Open 0b1111 CLEO Drops.
achievements.summary: Open a total of 15 CLEO Drops.

steps.text: Open CLEO Drops until you have opened 15 in total.
steps.note: The game writes 15 as the binary number 0b1111.

achievements.displayName: Sleep All Day, Out All Night
achievements.description: Survive 49 total zombie waves in Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Survive a combined total of 49 zombie waves across Daybreak sessions.

steps.text: Play Daybreak sessions and survive waves until your running total reaches 49.
steps.note: Waves from different sessions add together.

achievements.description: Survive 343 total zombie waves in Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Survive a combined total of 343 zombie waves across Daybreak sessions.

steps.text: Play Daybreak sessions and survive waves until your running total reaches 343.
steps.note: The game shows no counter, so keep your own tally.

achievements.description: Open 0b11111111 CLEO Drops.
achievements.summary: Open a total of 255 CLEO Drops.

steps.text: Open CLEO Drops until you have opened 255 in total.
steps.note: The game writes 255 as the binary number 0b11111111.

achievements.description: Earn a total of 5000 Prestige playing Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Earn a combined total of 5000 Prestige from Daybreak sessions.

steps.text: Play Daybreak sessions and survive waves until your earned Prestige totals 5000.

achievements.description: Survive to the fourth wave in a session of Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Survive until the fourth wave begins in a single Daybreak session.

steps.text: Defend the technician in one Daybreak session until the fourth wave starts.

achievements.description: Survive to the sixth wave in a session of Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Survive until the sixth wave begins in a single Daybreak session.

steps.text: Defend the technician in one Daybreak session until the sixth wave starts.

achievements.description: Play Daybreak with another human being.
achievements.summary: Play a Daybreak session together with another human player.

steps.text: Host a Daybreak session and let another human player join.
steps.note: Open the multiplayer options in Settings during the session and allow others to join.

achievements.description: Heal the technician 12 times in Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Heal the technician a combined total of 12 times in Daybreak.

steps.text: Heal the technician during Daybreak sessions until you have done it 12 times.

achievements.description: Repair a wall 12 times in Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Repair a wall a combined total of 12 times in Daybreak.

steps.text: Repair damaged walls during Daybreak sessions until you have done it 12 times.

achievements.displayName: The Moral High Ground is Mine
achievements.description: Reach the fourth wave in a session of Daybreak without any player using guns.
achievements.summary: Reach the fourth wave of a Daybreak session while no player fires a gun.

steps.text: Defend the technician with explosives and melee weapons, never guns, until the fourth wave begins.
steps.note: Gunfire from AI companions does not count against you in single player or with fewer than four human players.

achievements.description: Reach the fifth wave in a session of Daybreak without any player using explosives.
achievements.summary: Reach the fifth wave of a Daybreak session while no player uses explosives.

steps.text: Defend the technician with guns and melee weapons, never explosives, until the fifth wave begins.
steps.note: In a group, tell everyone not to place any explosives.

achievements.description: Reach the sixth wave in a session of Daybreak in single player.
achievements.summary: Reach the sixth wave of a Daybreak session in single player.

steps.text: Play Daybreak alone, with no other human players, until the sixth wave begins.

achievements.description: Reach the third wave in a session of Daybreak without the technician taking damage.
achievements.summary: Reach the third wave of a Daybreak session without the technician taking damage.

steps.text: Keep zombies away from the technician so the technician takes no damage until the third wave begins.

achievements.description: Achieve victory in a session of Daybreak without suffering any player deaths.
achievements.summary: Win a Daybreak session without any player dying.

steps.text: Win a Daybreak session while every player stays alive throughout.

achievements.description: Achieve victory in a session of Daybreak without any wall sections being leveled.
achievements.summary: Win a Daybreak session without any wall section being leveled.

steps.text: Win a Daybreak session while every wall section stays standing.

achievements.description: Achieve victory in a session of Daybreak after collecting 25 CLEO drops.
achievements.summary: Win a Daybreak session after collecting 25 CLEO Drops in that session.

steps.text: Collect 25 CLEO Drops during one Daybreak session and still win that session.

achievements.description: Allow the technician to die during a session of Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Let the technician die during a Daybreak session.

steps.text: Start a Daybreak session and let zombies kill the technician.

achievements.description: Fail during the first wave in a session of Daybreak.
achievements.summary: Lose a Daybreak session during its first wave.

steps.text: Start a Daybreak session and fail it before the first wave ends.

achievements.description: Have all four Red Talon facilities in your home community at the same time.
achievements.summary: Own the Bunkroom, Workshop, Watchtower and Officer Quarters Red Talon facilities together in your home community.

guide.context: Daybreak rewards come in tiers tied to waves 3, 5 and 7, and each reward is drawn from the lowest tier that still has rewards left. Wave 7 rewards therefore arrive only after every wave 3 and wave 5 reward is already unlocked.

steps.text: Survive wave 7 in Daybreak at least nine times after every wave 3 and wave 5 reward is unlocked, until every Red Talon facility is unlocked.
Buy the Bunkroom, Workshop, Watchtower and Officer Quarters with Prestige and build all four in your home community.
steps.note: Red Talon mods sold alongside do not count; you need the facilities.

steps.text: Use a base with the right slots: Bunkroom indoor small, Workshop indoor or outdoor small, Watchtower outdoor small, Officer Quarters indoor small.

achievements.description: Build a CLEO Relay facility in your home community.
achievements.summary: Construct the CLEO Relay facility at your home community's base.

guide.context: Daybreak rewards come in tiers tied to waves 3, 5 and 7, and each reward is drawn from the lowest tier that still has rewards left. Wave 7 rewards therefore arrive only after every wave 3 and wave 5 reward is already unlocked.

steps.text: Unlock the CLEO Relay by surviving wave 7 in Daybreak after every wave 3 and wave 5 reward is already unlocked.
steps.note: This takes at least nine wave 7 survivals.

steps.text: Pay its cost of 4000 Prestige.
steps.note: The Heartland CLEO Relay does not count.

steps.text: Build it on a large outdoor slot in your home community.

achievements.description: Kill a blood plague juggernaut.
achievements.summary: Kill one blood plague Juggernaut.

steps.text: Find and kill a blood plague @enemy{Juggernaut}.
steps.note: On Lethal minimum difficulty one can appear near your base at the start of the second day.

achievements.description: Recruit four Red Talon contractors to your home community.
achievements.summary: Recruit four Red Talon contractors into your home community.

steps.text: Survive wave 3, 5 or 7 in Daybreak sessions to unlock Red Talon contractors for purchase.
In the main campaign, spend Prestige to recruit a Red Talon contractor into your home community, and repeat until you have recruited four.
steps.note: Each paid recruit counts, even across different communities. Survivors carried into a new game do not count.

achievements.description: Kill a screamer with a CLEO heavy sniper rifle.
achievements.summary: Use the CLEO heavy sniper rifle to shoot dead a Screamer.

guide.context: Daybreak rewards come in tiers tied to waves 3, 5 and 7, and each reward is drawn from the lowest tier that still has rewards left. Wave 7 rewards therefore arrive only after every wave 3 and wave 5 reward is already unlocked.

steps.text: Unlock the CLEO heavy sniper rifle by surviving wave 7 in Daybreak eight times.
Find a @enemy{Screamer} and kill it with that rifle.

achievements.description: Allow 24 bags of dropped items to accumulate on the ground.
achievements.summary: Let 24 bags of dropped items pile up on the ground in a Daybreak session.

steps.text: Drop items one at a time in a Daybreak session until 24 bags lie on the ground.
steps.note: Dropping single bullets is the quickest way.

achievements.displayName: Am I the Only One Zen Around Here?
achievements.description: Kill 50 plague zombies with crossbows.
achievements.summary: Kill fifty plague zombies with crossbow shots.

steps.text: Get a crossbow and bolts.
steps.note: Crossbows turn up in loot or a random mysterious broadcast event; spent bolts can be picked up again.

steps.text: Use the crossbow to kill plague zombies until you have fifty.
steps.note: Plague zombies spawn inside the houses of Plague Hearts.

achievements.displayName: Should Have Read the Warning Label
achievements.description: Contract blood plague by using a plague consumable.
achievements.summary: Use a plague consumable so that you contract blood plague.

steps.text: Craft or buy a plague consumable and use it.
steps.note: A long timer on it is fine because plague does not drop quickly. Isaac in Heartland makes consumables easy to craft.

achievements.description: Use a training manual to retrain a specialization.
achievements.summary: Retrain a specialization with a training manual.

steps.text: Have a survivor whose core skill specialization is fully maxed.
Buy a training manual from the Mysterious Wandering Trader; it costs 1500 Influence.
steps.note: He may visit on real-life days from Friday through Sunday.

steps.text: Use the manual on that survivor to drop the specialization and pick a different standard one.

achievements.description: Complete the legacy arcs for all four leader types while in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Finish the legacy arc of the Sheriff, Warlord, Builder and Trader leader types in campaigns played in Dread Zones or Nightmare Zones.

guide.context: Raising the difficulty of an existing community resets its map: your base, enclaves, Plague Hearts and outposts are lost, while survivors, gear, stash, Influence, resources and parked cars are kept.

steps.text: Plan four campaigns at Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty, one for each leader type.
In each campaign, destroy every Plague Heart, elect that leader type and finish the leader's Legacy mission.
steps.note: The Builder and Trader final fights give you backup, so they suit Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Carry up to three of your best survivors with their gear into the next campaign.

achievements.description: Have a survivor within your community die while playing in a Dread Zone.
achievements.summary: Lose one of your community's survivors to death during play in a Dread Zone.

steps.text: Start or continue a community whose difficulty is set to Dread Zone.
Send a survivor into a group of zombies and let that survivor be killed.
steps.note: Death is permanent, so use someone you can afford to lose.

achievements.description: Have three survivors within your community die in a Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Lose three of your community's survivors to death on Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty.

steps.text: Play a community at Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty and let three of its survivors be killed.
steps.note: Deaths are permanent, so spend survivors you do not need.

achievements.description: Play in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone with another human being.
achievements.summary: Take a Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone community into a session shared with another human player.

steps.text: In a community at Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty, turn on Host Multiplayer Game in the Settings multiplayer options.
Open the radio, choose Multiplayer, then Call for Help, and wait for another human player to join.

achievements.displayName: Do Not Go Gentle into That Good Night
achievements.description: Enter a Dread Zone.
achievements.summary: Start playing a community whose difficulty is set to Dread Zone.

steps.text: Start a new community and choose the Dread Zone difficulty.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks when the world loads after you pick a legacy and survivors.

achievements.displayName: Rage Against the Dying of the Light
achievements.description: Enter a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Start playing a community whose difficulty is set to Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Start a new community and choose the Nightmare Zone difficulty.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks when the world loads after you pick a legacy and survivors.

achievements.description: Survive until Day 100 while in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Keep a Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone community alive until the calendar reaches Day 100.

guide.context: Do not lower the host's difficulty to Standard or Green Zone at any point during the run. A joining player on Green Zone does not reset your progress.

steps.text: Keep one community at Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty and play it until the day counter reaches 100.
steps.note: Strong weapons and good facilities help you hold out against heavy sieges.

achievements.description: Complete a legacy arc while in a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Finish a legacy arc while playing a community in a Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Start a community at Nightmare Zone difficulty.
Destroy every Plague Heart in the territory.
Elect a leader and finish that leader's Legacy mission.
steps.note: The Builder legacy is the simplest because its final fight happens at your base with backup.

achievements.description: Kill all plague hearts in a single Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Destroy every Plague Heart in a single Nightmare Zone community.

steps.text: Start a community at Nightmare Zone difficulty.
Find each Plague Heart on the map and destroy it.
steps.note: Two or three remote explosives such as @item{C4} usually kill a heart; scout by car and look for red glow from buildings.

achievements.description: Destroy a plague heart in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Take down one Plague Heart in a community set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Find a Plague Heart by driving the roads or calling for its location on the radio.
Clear the zombies from its building, plant two or three remote explosives such as @item{C4}, retreat to a safe distance and detonate them.
steps.note: A badly hurt heart releases gas and calls zombies, so leave the building before it bursts.

achievements.description: Earn 1000 Influence from killing freaks.
achievements.summary: Earn a total of one thousand Influence from kills of freaks.

steps.text: Kill Ferals, Bloaters, Screamers and Juggernauts and collect the Influence they give until the total reaches 1000.
steps.note: Each kill pays about 5 to 50 Influence on standard difficulty, more on Dread and Nightmare.

achievements.description: Reach maximum morale while in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Bring community morale up to its highest level on Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty.

steps.text: Play a community at Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone difficulty.
Build comfort facilities at your base, such as a Garden, Latrine, Lounge, Beds and an Infirmary, until morale reaches its maximum.

achievements.description: Destroy an XL Horde (a large horde with two Screamers and a Feral) while in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Wipe out an XL Horde, which includes two Screamers and a Feral, in a community set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Hold your base in a community set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone until an XL Horde shows up.
Kill the horde's zombies, including its @enemy{Screamer}s and @enemy{Feral}, until the horde is destroyed.

achievements.description: Craft a case of bulk plague cure while in a Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Make one case of bulk plague cure in a community set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Build an Infirmary at your base.
Use the Infirmary to make one case of bulk plague cure while the community is set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.

achievements.description: Extract 20 plague samples from plague juggernauts in a Dread Zone or a Nightmare Zone.
achievements.summary: Gather 20 plague samples dropped by plague Juggernauts in a community set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Grab the sample package that each plague @enemy{Juggernaut} leaves behind on Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone communities until you have picked up 20 samples in total.
steps.note: An ally can make the kill; only the pickup matters.

achievements.description: Destroy 100 hordes in Dread Zones or Nightmare Zones.
achievements.summary: Defeat 100 hordes in total across communities set to Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone.

steps.text: Destroy hordes in Dread Zone or Nightmare Zone communities until the total reaches 100.
steps.note: Fuel bombs or a sturdy vehicle driven into the horde speed this up.

achievements.description: Kill 25 blood juggs in Heartland
achievements.summary: Kill 25 blood Juggernauts in Heartland.

steps.text: Kill blood @enemy{Juggernaut}s in Heartland until you have killed 25.
steps.note: Plague walls are a good place to find them.

achievements.description: Kill 25 blood ferals in Heartland
achievements.summary: Kill 25 blood Ferals in Heartland.

steps.text: Kill blood @enemy{Feral}s in Heartland until you have killed 25.
steps.note: Plague walls are a good place to find them.

achievements.description: Kill 25 plague screamers in Heartland
achievements.summary: Kill 25 plague Screamers in Heartland.

steps.text: Kill plague @enemy{Screamer}s in Heartland until you have killed 25.

achievements.description: Destroy a plague wall in Heartland
achievements.summary: Destroy a plague wall in Heartland.

steps.text: Follow Captain Logan's missions to the plague wall at the Crashed Plane Site.
Fight the wall with plague busters and your weapons until it falls.

achievements.description: Play Heartland in multiplayer as the host or client
achievements.summary: Join or host a multiplayer game of Heartland.

steps.text: Choose the multiplayer option when starting Heartland and connect with another player.

achievements.description: Use the Weapons Depot to craft all four of the Network weapons in Heartland
achievements.summary: Craft all four Network weapons at the Weapons Depot in Heartland.

guide.context: This goal needs Quincy as a starting survivor, which means the Santos story. The vehicle-kit goal needs Larisse's story instead, so you need two Heartland runs for both.

steps.text: Start Heartland with Quincy as one of your starting survivors, which is the Santos story.
Upgrade the Repair Depot, then make four items at the Weapons Depot: the Masterwork Assault Rifle, the Homemade Assault Rifle, the Suppressed Bolt-Action Rifle and the Lead-Filled Bat.
steps.note: Keep Quincy alive, since his weaponsmithing does the crafting.

achievements.description: Use the Vehicle Depot to craft and use all three vehicle upgrade kits.
achievements.summary: Craft all three vehicle upgrade kits at the Vehicle Depot in Heartland and apply each one to a vehicle.

guide.context: This goal needs Larisse as a starting survivor, which means the Wilkerson story. The weapon-crafting goal needs Quincy's story instead, so you need two Heartland runs for both.

steps.text: Start Heartland with Larisse as one of your starting survivors, which is the Wilkerson story.
Help Malik reclaim his base and upgrade the Repair Depot.
Craft the Light, Medium and Heavy upgrade kits at the Vehicle Depot and apply each kit to a vehicle.

achievements.description: Recruit 8 different survivors in a single game of Heartland.
achievements.summary: Bring eight distinct survivors into one Heartland game's community.

steps.text: Recruit Malik, Captain Logan, Chavez, Reba, Diana and IzzBee.
Also recruit one of Keesha or Brock, and one of Vic or Isaac.
steps.note: A recruit who dies afterward still counts.

achievements.description: Recruit Malik into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Malik into your Heartland community.

steps.text: Play the opening missions of Heartland until Malik joins after the opening Feral.

achievements.description: Recruit Brock into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Brock into your Heartland community.

guide.context: Brock comes only with Larisse's story. Keesha comes only with Quincy's story, so one run gets one of them.

steps.text: Start Heartland with Larisse and Fiona as your starting survivors and follow Larisse's story until Brock joins.

achievements.description: Recruit Keesha into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Keesha into your Heartland community.

guide.context: Keesha comes only with Quincy's story. Brock comes only with Larisse's story, so one run gets one of them.

steps.text: Start Heartland with Quincy as a starting survivor and follow the Santos story.
Clear the plague-infested warehouse northwest of Marshall; Keesha joins afterward.

achievements.description: Recruit Chavez into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Chavez into your Heartland community.

steps.text: Survive the surprise siege on your base.
Go to the cave northwest of the plane crash and answer his radio call for help.

achievements.description: Recruit Reba into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Reba into your Heartland community.

steps.text: After day 3, answer Reba's call and go to her house on the road to the Wilkerson enclave, northeast of your base.

achievements.description: Recruit Diana into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Diana into your Heartland community.

steps.text: Near the farm barn on the southern road, in the bottom middle of the map, help Diana when she calls.
After Logan's second mission, help her a second time by the bridge on Marshall's east side.
steps.note: Recruit her early in the story.

achievements.description: Recruit Vic into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Vic into your Heartland community.

steps.text: Survive the siege on your home base about an hour into the story.
When the game offers the choice between Vic and Isaac, choose Vic.
steps.note: Plan on only one of the two joining in the same run.

achievements.description: Recruit Isaac into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit Isaac into your Heartland community.

steps.text: Survive the siege on your home base about an hour into the story.
When the game offers the choice between Vic and Isaac, choose Isaac.
steps.note: Plan on only one of the two joining in the same run.

achievements.description: Recruit IzzBee into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Recruit IzzBee into your Heartland community.

steps.text: Destroy the plague wall at the Crashed Plane Site.
Continue Captain Logan's missions around Spencer's Mill until IzzBee joins.

achievements.description: Recruit Captain Logan into your Heartland community
achievements.summary: Get Captain Logan to join your Heartland community.

steps.text: Survive the first siege on your Heartland base; Logan joins your story from there.

achievements.description: Use plague cure on your own survivor 100 times in Heartland
achievements.summary: Cure your own survivor of plague with plague cure 100 times in Heartland.

steps.text: Keep a stock of plague cures; make them at an Infirmary or buy them.
Get infected at a plague wall puddle and use a cure on yourself, repeating until you have done it 100 times.
steps.note: A cure at any infection level counts, and a follower curing the character you control counts toward both this and Playing Doctor.

achievements.description: Use plague cure on another survivor 100 times in Heartland
achievements.summary: Cure a different survivor of plague with plague cure 100 times in Heartland.

steps.text: Keep a stock of plague cures; make them at an Infirmary or buy them.
Get your followers infected at a plague wall puddle, or alternate between two characters at a plague wall so each cures the other, until you have done it 100 times.
steps.note: A follower curing the character you control counts toward both this and Heal Thyself.

achievements.description: Complete 10 CLEO sieges using the CLEO relay in Heartland
achievements.summary: Finish 10 CLEO sieges in Heartland with your CLEO Relay.

steps.text: Recruit IzzBee, then build the CLEO Relay at your Heartland base.
Complete 10 CLEO sieges using the relay.

achievements.description: Kill 10 or more enemies with a single plague buster
achievements.summary: Take out at least 10 enemies using one plague buster.

steps.text: Wait until the story gives you a plague buster.
Pull a big group of zombies together, for example with lures near a Plague Heart or Infestation, and throw the plague buster into the crowd.
steps.note: The Crashed Plane Site is one place with large crowds.

achievements.description: Complete Heartland while playing alone
achievements.summary: Finish the Heartland story while playing alone.

steps.text: Play Heartland solo and destroy the final plague wall to complete the story.
steps.note: After the ending the last wall returns, so you can fight it again alone if needed.

achievements.description: Complete Heartland as the host or client in multiplayer
achievements.summary: Finish the Heartland story in multiplayer as the host or as a client.

steps.text: Before destroying the final plague wall, open the radio and call for help.
When another player joins, destroy the final plague wall together.
steps.note: Plague walls gain health with each extra player.

achievements.description: Complete Heartland with both of your starting survivors alive
achievements.summary: Finish the Heartland story with both of your starting survivors still alive.

steps.text: Keep both starting survivors alive through the whole story.
Leave them at the base during the final battle.
steps.note: Farm bloater glands beforehand to make plague busters.

achievements.description: Find all six different Echo Labs guns in Heartland during a single playthrough as the host
achievements.summary: Find all six Echo Labs guns in a single Heartland playthrough as the host.

steps.text: Host Heartland yourself for the whole run.
Search military outposts, med tents, roadblocks and their green or dark blue crates, mostly in east Marshall, until all six Echo guns are found.
steps.note: Keep each gun in your stash.

achievements.description: Destroy 20 plague walls in Heartland
achievements.summary: Destroy a combined total of 20 plague walls in Heartland.

guide.context: A Heartland story has only 5 plague walls, so reaching 20 needs the last wall to be fought again after the ending or additional story runs.

steps.text: Destroy the five plague walls of a Heartland story run.
Fight the revived last wall again after the ending, repeating until your total reaches 20.
steps.note: Each wall adds one twentieth to the counter.

achievements.description: Claim a base on the Providence Ridge map.
achievements.summary: Set up your community's base in Providence Ridge.

steps.text: Skip the tutorial and start a campaign game.
Take the Firewatch Tower site on the path beyond the broken bus, or relocate to another base on that map.
steps.note: The base you start with in the tutorial is already yours and gives no credit.

achievements.description: Accept a bounty from the Bounty Broker.
achievements.summary: Take a bounty from the Bounty Broker.

steps.text: Travel to the Bounty Broker, whose marker sits at the center of every map except Heartland.
Speak with him and take a bounty.

achievements.description: Complete 5 bounties for the Bounty Broker.
achievements.summary: Complete five bounties for the Bounty Broker.

guide.context: You can hold only three bounties at a time, and only held bounties progress. To make progress on another one, swap a bounty you are not working on for it at the Broker.

steps.text: Accept and finish bounties from the @npc{Bounty Broker} until five are done.

achievements.description: Complete 25 bounties for the Bounty Broker.
achievements.summary: Complete twenty-five bounties for the Bounty Broker.

guide.context: You can hold only three bounties at a time, and only held bounties progress. To make progress on another one, swap a bounty you are not working on for it at the Broker.

steps.text: Keep accepting and finishing bounties from the @npc{Bounty Broker} until twenty-five are done.

achievements.displayName: It Looks Good on You, Though
achievements.description: Unlock an outfit by completing a bounty from the Bounty Broker.
achievements.summary: Unlock an outfit by finishing a Bounty Broker bounty.

steps.text: Complete bounties from the @npc{Bounty Broker} until one pays out clothing.
steps.note: Available bounties rotate with game updates, so check the Broker again if none offers an outfit.

achievements.description: Kill 3 zombies in 3 seconds with a revolver, while wearing any cowboy hat from the Closet.
achievements.summary: Kill three zombies within three seconds using a revolver while wearing a cowboy hat from the Closet.

steps.text: Find a cowboy hat by looting buildings.
Find a revolver, not a pistol; plague hearts and random loot can give one, and the Bounty Broker may offer one as a reward.
Wear the hat from the Closet and kill three zombies in three seconds with the revolver.

achievements.description: Hit top speed while driving a Road Racer and wearing any puffy vest from the Closet.
achievements.summary: Reach top speed in a Road Racer while wearing a puffy vest from the Closet.

steps.text: Wear a puffy vest, which unlocks by itself and is chosen in the Community tab.
Drive a Road Racer and reach its top speed.
steps.note: Road Racers can appear on any map and might need repairs and fuel.

achievements.description: Kill a plague heart with minimum difficulty set to Lethal.
achievements.summary: Kill a Plague Heart with Lethal as the minimum difficulty.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Plague Heart}; hearts are common on Lethal and can show up from Day 1.
Destroy it with remote explosives set off from a safe distance, or snipe it from a car roof if the building has many windows.

achievements.displayName: Bless Me Now With Your Fierce Tears
achievements.description: Begin a session with minimum difficulty set to Lethal.
achievements.summary: Begin a session with Lethal as the minimum difficulty.

steps.text: Begin a fresh Lethal community, or push an existing one up to Lethal and confirm the warning about a new map.
It unlocks soon after the new map loads.
steps.note: If it does not unlock, reconnect your Steam and Xbox accounts from the Multiplayer menu, then restart the game.

achievements.description: Kill 25 blood plague bloaters.
achievements.summary: Kill twenty-five blood plague Bloaters.

steps.text: Stay on main roads and kill blood plague @enemy{Bloater}s as they show up until twenty-five have died.

achievements.description: Kill one each of the four blood plague freaks with minimum difficulty set to Lethal.
achievements.summary: Kill each of the four kinds of blood plague freak while Lethal is the minimum difficulty.

steps.text: Hunt blood plague freaks on Lethal; all but the Juggernaut can be found on Day 1.
Look for Screamers in Infestations, Ferals and Juggernauts around Plague Hearts, and Bloaters in hordes or roaming.
Kill the blood plague Juggernaut when it appears.
steps.note: It may only show up from the start of Day 2.

achievements.displayName: Biggest Ball of Twine in Minnesota
achievements.description: Claim a landmark outpost.
achievements.summary: Claim one landmark outpost.

guide.context: A community that started before the Landmarks update must move to a new map, or change difficulty on its current one, before landmarks appear; either way keeps Influence, characters and stash. Each map has one landmark. Known landmarks: Leeds Concrete Silos (Cascade Hills), Sasser Regional Hospital (Drucker County), Wind Mills (Meagher Valley), New Hope Church (Providence Ridge), Echo Lab Research Station (Trumbull Valley).

steps.text: Find the landmark outpost by its unique map icon.
Destroy any nearby @enemy{Plague Heart} first.
Claim the outpost for 1000 Influence.
steps.note: On Green Zone the price is 500. Only the host receives the unlock in co-op.

achievements.description: Claim any 3 landmark outposts.
achievements.summary: Claim landmark outposts on three different maps.

guide.context: The same landmark does not count three times; use three different maps.

steps.text: Claim the landmark outpost on one map.
Tap the move-community icon, travel to another map and claim its landmark.
Move once more and claim a third landmark on a third map.
steps.note: Only the host receives the unlock in co-op.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a resource outpost.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade a resource outpost.

steps.text: Claim a resource outpost.
Spend Influence to upgrade it twice.
steps.note: Some outposts only offer the upgrade when your community has a specific skill.

achievements.description: Claim a base in the Trumbull Valley map (outside of Heartland).
achievements.summary: Establish a base on Trumbull Valley, the regular-campaign map and not the Heartland one.

steps.text: Start a new Green community and skip the tutorial, or tap the move-community icon on your map and travel to Trumbull Valley.
Establish a base at the flag there.

achievements.displayName: You're So Fine You Blow My Mind
achievements.description: Complete Mickey Wilkerson's story in Trumbull Valley (outside of Heartland).
achievements.summary: Finish Mickey Wilkerson's storyline in Trumbull Valley, in the regular campaign and not Heartland.

guide.context: Ray Santos has to appear for the story to finish. A hotfix shortened the chain, and it can still take several in-game days of waiting.

steps.text: Take Mickey to the Homestead.
Pick up the Old Photo from the nearby stash northeast of Pterodactyl Park, north of the church with a graveyard.
After taking the photo, call Mickey, meet at the bar and do the short mission.
Complete the Ray Santos mission that relocates him to the church base; Mickey's fourth mission then ends the story.
